children: BOUND BROOK, N.J., Sept. 17, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- SR Bancorp, Inc. (

), the holding company for Somerset Regal Bank, announced that its Board of Directors has declared the payment of a quarterly cash dividend. The dividend of $0.06 per share will be paid on October 15, 2026 to stockholders of record as of September 30, 2026.
David Orbach, Executive Chairman of SR Bancorp, Inc said: "We are pleased to be in a strong financial position giving us the ability to pay a cash dividend."

SR Bancorp, Inc. is the holding company for Somerset Regal Bank, a full-service New Jersey commercial bank headquartered in Bound Brook, New Jersey that operates 14 branches in Essex, Hunterdon, Middlesex, Morris, Somerset and Union Counties, New Jersey. At June 30, 2026, Somerset Regal Bank had $1.19 billion in total assets, $901.2 million in net loans, $926.4 million in deposits and total equity of $181.8 million.
